title: Call Kim after the party
intro: Your head hurts. On your hand, half smudged: Kim's number. And a voice message from 02:14.

rounds.prompt: Kim's number is on your hand, half smudged. Fill in the gaps.

texts.en: PS: I've got your phone charger

clip.name: Kim
clip.style: A giggly, slightly tipsy young person leaving a voice message at 2 a.m., shouting over loud party music, warm and playful, laughing on "Haha", but saying every digit of the phone number slowly and clearly.
clip.de: Heeey! Ich bin's, Kim, von der Tanzfläche! Haha! Okay, okay, hör zu: Meine Nummer ist null, eins, sieben, sechs – fünf, zwei, null – drei, acht, vier, sieben. Ruf mich an! Morgen! Oder heute! Egal!
clip.en: Heeey! It's me, Kim, from the dance floor! Haha! Okay, okay, listen: my number is 0176 520 3847. Call me! Tomorrow! Or today! Whatever!

rounds.prompt: Tom reads out Kim's work number. Careful: Tom isn't sure either.

clip.name: Tom, Kim's flatmate
clip.style: A man who was just woken up by the phone: groggy, grumpy, yawning, mumbling a little, then annoyed with himself when he gets a digit wrong. Still say each digit clearly.
clip.de: Mmh … hallo? Wer ist da? … Kim? Nee, Kim ist nicht da. Kim ist schon bei der Arbeit. Am Sonntag! Verrückt. Die Nummer da ist null, eins, sieben, sechs – neun, eins, drei – null, zwei … nein, Quatsch! Null, acht, sechs, vier. Gute Nacht.
clip.en: Mmh… hello? Who's there? … Kim? Nah, Kim's not here. Kim's already at work. On a Sunday! Crazy. The number there is 0176 913 02… no, nonsense! 0864. Good night.

rounds.prompt: You saved it three times in a hurry. Which one did they say?

clip.name: Lindner's office
clip.style: An over-the-top cheerful office receptionist with a bright, sing-song customer-service voice, a little too enthusiastic for a Sunday morning. Say the phone number clearly, digit by digit.
clip.de: Büro Lindner, schönen Sonntag! Was kann ich für Sie tun? Kim? Oh, Kim ist leider schon weg! Aber hier ist die Privatnummer: null, eins, sieben, sechs – vier, acht, fünf – zwei, sieben, eins, sechs. Schönen Tag noch!
clip.en: Lindner's office, happy Sunday! How can I help? Kim? Oh, Kim's already gone, I'm afraid! But here's the private number: 0176 485 2716. Have a lovely day!

ending.name: Kim
ending.style: A sleepy young person picking up the phone, then suddenly surprised and delighted, laughing, warm and a bit flirty-friendly.
ending.de: Hallo? … Waaas, du rufst wirklich an? Haha! Ich dachte, du hast meine Nummer verloren! Okay: Kaffee um drei? Ich bring dein Ladekabel mit!
ending.en: Hello? … Whaaat, you're actually calling? Haha! I thought you'd lost my number! Okay: coffee at three? I'll bring your charger!

wrong.name: A grandma in Bavaria
wrong.de: Jessas! Wer ruft denn um diese Zeit an? Es ist Sonntag! Ich bin achtzig Jahre alt, und ich schlafe!
wrong.en: Good heavens! Who calls at this hour? It's Sunday! I'm eighty years old, and I'm sleeping!
wrong.caption: You just woke up a grandma in Bavaria 👵
wrong.style: A very old Bavarian grandmother woken up on a Sunday: outraged, croaky, scolding, dramatic.

wrong.name: Pizzeria Bella
wrong.de: Pizzeria Bella, ciao! Eine Margherita? Zwei? Drei? Hallo? Sagen Sie doch was! … Okay, ich mach einfach drei.
wrong.en: Pizzeria Bella, ciao! A margherita? Two? Three? Hello? Say something! … Okay, I'll just make three.
wrong.caption: Wrong number. Three pizzas are on their way to you 🍕
wrong.style: A stressed, fast-talking, friendly pizza cook in a loud kitchen, a bit impatient, then cheerfully decides for you.

wrong.name: Answering machine
wrong.de: Zahnarztpraxis Doktor Weiß. Wir haben geschlossen. Bei Zahnschmerzen drücken Sie die Eins. Bei sehr großen Zahnschmerzen … drücken Sie die Zwei.
wrong.en: Dr Weiß's dental practice. We are closed. For toothache, press one. For a really bad toothache … press two.
wrong.caption: A dentist's answering machine 🦷 Press two if it really hurts.
wrong.style: A bored, flat, monotone recorded answering-machine message at a normal pace, with a tiny deadpan pause before the last sentence.

wrong.name: FitBerlin hotline
wrong.de: Willkommen bei FitBerlin! Für Kurse drücken Sie die Eins! Für die Sauna die Zwei! Und jetzt: zehn Liegestütze! Los! Eins! Zwei! Drei!
wrong.en: Welcome to FitBerlin! For classes press one! For the sauna, two! And now: ten push-ups! Go! One! Two! Three!
wrong.caption: A gym hotline. You did three push-ups. In bed. 💪
wrong.style: An extremely pumped, shouting fitness coach full of energy, like a workout video, counting the push-ups loudly.

wrong.name: Taxi Berlin
wrong.de: Taxi Berlin, wat is? Wohin soll’s gehen? … Hallo? Na, dann eben nicht!
wrong.en: Taxi Berlin, what's up? Where to? … Hello? Well, fine then!
wrong.caption: A Berlin taxi driver. He's already offended 🚕
wrong.style: A gruff, impatient Berlin taxi driver with a strong Berlin attitude, quickly offended.
